header.description: Two-ship Yak-3 + La-7 envelope-interpolation scenario -- the golden pinning the two roster airframes' generated envelope-table entries in C++ <-> Python lockstep. The ships are near-antipodal (lon 0 vs lon 180, ~47 km apart on the 94 km-circumference sphere) so they can never interact; each flies a profile chosen to traverse its OWN phi_max/roll_rate LUT interpolation segments and its B1/B3/B5 aero, then fires a closing burst so per-airframe weapon scalars (muzzle_v 800, rof 7 vs 6, convergence 180 vs 200, damage 28 vs 30, ammo 140 vs 170) are pinned as LIVE rounds in the sealed final snapshot. RE-DESIGNED FOR B5 (v1.21r0) with dive phases after sigma(alt) degenerated the original crossings; RE-MEASURED AT v1.22r0 (supercharger critical altitude): rated power below crit_alt_m shifted every crossing tick and un-bled the La-7 tail, so the two float/fire phases stiffen to g 1.6 to restore the 85 m/s crossing -- all numbers below are MEASURED under v1.22r0. The profile straddles BOTH supercharger lapse branches: the Yak-3 (crit_alt_m 3000) flies its whole profile just ABOVE its critical altitude (lapse ~0.95), the La-7 (crit_alt_m 4500) flies entirely BELOW its own (lapse = 1, rated power). AC0 (Yak-3, equator, psi 90, 3500 m, TAS 150 -- strictly inside the [120,160] LUT segment): phase 0 commands bank 70 deg (over-limit -> the interpolated phi_max clamp binds ~47-48 deg, roll_rate(V) slew shapes the roll-in) at g 1.35 / full throttle -- a gently descending accelerating spiral (g below the ~1.47 level-turn requirement) that crosses the 160 m/s breakpoint UPWARD at t~1067; phase 1 (t=1500) reverses to bank -20 at g 1.3 / throttle 0 -- the ~68 deg reversal exercises the roll_rate slew in the [160,185] segment while the zoom + induced drag bleed TAS back DOWN through 160 at t~1918; phase 2 (t=2500) levels; phase 3 (t=2800) fires to the end -- 29 rounds at rof 7 (ammo 140->111), all inside the 250-tick TTL at tick 3000. TAS stays in [146.0, 164.8], gamma in [-4.1, +3.8] deg. AC1 (La-7, lat 10 / lon 180, psi 270, 3000 m, TAS 110 -- strictly inside the [85,125] segment): phase 0 commands bank -60 (over-limit -> clamps at the interpolated ~-52 deg) at g 1.62 / full throttle; phase 1 (t=1000) pushes over to g 0.05 full throttle -- the dive builds TAS through the 125 m/s breakpoint UPWARD at t~1092 and on to 153.6 while altitude falls to ~2711 m (sigma RISES as it descends -- the B5 coupling, now at RATED power); phase 2 (t=1800) is a 1 s g 8.0 pull at bank 30 -- n_aero stays in [9.45, 9.72] > 8 through the pull, so the STRUCTURAL limit (n_max_struct 8) is the binding B3 clamp throughout; phase 3 (t=1900) is a g 3.0 wings-level ZOOM (TAS bleeds back DOWN through 125 at t~2447); phase 4 (t=2500) bleeds hard at g 1.6 / throttle 0 (the v1.22r0 stiffening -- induced drag rises with n^2); phase 5 (t=2800) fires to the end at g 1.6 / throttle 0.7 while TAS falls DOWN through the 85 m/s breakpoint at t~2912 (three LUT segments visited), ending ~78 m/s in a nose-high mush (gamma ~+77 deg, inside the documented +/-90 deg model envelope) -- 34 rounds at rof 6 (ammo 170->136). No round can connect (owner-excluded, nearest foreign target ~40 km): hp/regions stay full, kills 0, last_hit_by -1 -- this golden pins TRAJECTORY + weapon-scalar determinism, not combat (Hit/Winchester/EngineOut own those). Exercises: piecewise-linear LUT interpolation at non-breakpoint TAS for both envtab entries, LUT segment switches in both directions, the phi_max clamp + roll_rate slew, both B3 load-factor clamps (the aero ceiling in the Yak-3 reversal, the structural limit in the La-7 pull), B1 thrust/drag integration with both aero parameter sets, the B5 sigma(alt) LUT across a ~650 m dive/zoom band, BOTH v1.22r0 supercharger lapse branches, and the G3/G4/v1.15r0 weapon scalar set live in the snapshot bytes.
header.introduced: first golden covering the Yak-3/La-7 generated envelope-table entries (added post-v1.19r0, code 223ebd5, originally no-seal riding v1.19r0); schedules RE-DESIGNED at B5 (v1.21r0) against measured ISA-atmosphere dynamics, then RE-MEASURED at v1.22r0 (supercharger critical altitude) with the two La-7 tail phases stiffened to g 1.6 to restore the 85 m/s crossing rated power had un-bled, see ADR-Step8-FlightModel-Supercharger-v1.22r0.
